sections.title: Lehet with an infinitive
sections.content: *lehet* means 'it is possible'. With an infinitive it says what one can do: *A parkban lehet sétálni.* (In the park you can walk.) It is a general statement with no person: *lehet* never changes, and the infinitive has no ending. Ask *Itt lehet parkolni?* (Can one park here?) or *Hol lehet ebédelni?* (Where can one have lunch?). Say no with *nem*: *Itt nem lehet parkolni.* (One cannot park here.) New word: *lehet*.

items.english: In the park you can walk.

sections.content: Compare *kell* and *lehet*: *Itt kell fizetni.* (You have to pay here.) *Itt lehet fizetni.* (You can pay here.)
